materials.body: LIVE-XM-S2: Conceptual diagram of the formative loop. Intended learning shapes useful evidence; evidence is interpreted; interpretation informs action; action may generate further evidence. Do not add stages beyond these four warranted elements.

LIVE-XM-S4: Worked example. A short student response is read against two criteria and one exemplar excerpt; the lecturer names the quality gap and one feasible next step the student can take. The point is shared judgement, not comment volume.
materials.formal_notes: Example stays inside the evidence-to-action loop.

materials.body: LIVE-XM-S6: Synthesis diagram reusing the S2 four-part structure. Judgement may involve lecturer, peer, or self contributors, but those roles are not extra stages. The design question remains: what useful action can follow from the evidence?
